extracted.stage: Pre-grant; inheritance tax due before grant issues, grant expected within 15 weeks
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of an £875,500 Cheltenham estate enquires about a £74,500 probate loan to pay inheritance tax before the grant is issued.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding funding for the executors of the Cheltenham estate. We have noted the estate value of £875,500 and the £74,500 sought towards the inheritance tax liability. To take this further we would need the names and contact details of the executors, a breakdown of the estate assets and liabilities (including the property address and any valuation), details of the IHT calculation and the relevant HMRC payment date, confirmation of your firm's retainer, and any existing charges or claims against the estate. Once we have those details a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you.
